end.parentNote: Rohan practised describing 3 equal groups of 4 as “3 times 4” and skip-counting 4, 8, 12. They correctly identified the group with the same number in each plate and used repeated addition when prompted. They sometimes counted the groups instead of the objects inside; this mix-up was still present at the end. At home, make small groups with buttons or snacks and ask, “How many groups? How many in each group? How many altogether?”
